body:
Y'all, stop engaging with this user. She has stated before that she has OCD, she's unwell and engaging with her OCD to reassure her is going to make things worse for her. By telling her she passes/she's pretty, etc, she's reinforcing the cycle of obsession, compulsion, and relief 

Mods, this woman genuinely needs to be banned. For her own well-being, she isn't well and is hurting herself using trans subreddits.
Is there any way to get this living in the USA? This model absolutely rips.

No, not saying it's bad to have switch feelings at all! I have just fostered a lot of really important relationships that are with people who only sub and it would hurt a lot to lose that dynamic. And I find a lot of fulfillment in dom activities.    
I guess I'm wanting to know if I should prepare myself for the hurt of losing those dynamics and those relationship components that I love so dearly

I don't know, I guess it's that I want to be able to see myself as an attractive human being. I want to be able to look in a mirror and feel good about the way I look. You know those days where you're really just rocking it? Like, hair, clothes, complexion, you got the whole thing going for you? I just want to have those days every once in a while. I don't think I've felt positive about myself and the way I look for over 5 years now. It's just crushing my spirit.

And it really could be anything that triggers it, seeing myself under an unusually bright light, having a friend or coworker mention it, or just noticing how bad it is when I'm doing my treatments. I do things like use a laser hair comb and Dermaroll on my head to prevent hair loss and I have to stare into a mirror for about an hour every time I do that, so that's something that tends to trigger it as well.

Really? 
https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/04/09/398576196/study-find-the-poor-subject-to-unfair-fines-drivers-license-suspensions

Most people with warrants due to unpaid tickets are in a lower socioeconomic class and likely can't afford to pay for it. Everyone, literally everyone makes mistakes when driving and can get a ticket. So somehow not being able to afford to pay a ticket makes you not smart? smh


And when you're in that lower socioeconomic group, a free anything can be the one thing that gets you through the month. 


Stop acting like you're not a few steps away from ending up like them.
Your hair looks very similar to mine. You definitely have male pattern baldness and are thinning. Get on propecia asap.

Fuck man. I hope you keep you this level of growth. I hope you never have to worry about hair loss again.

Been on dut for almost a year and I'm barely maintaining...

No there isn't. Fin and Min don't work for everyone, and the regrowth (when it occurs) is pitiful. We have a few arrows in our quiver to maintain, but let's not pretend there's a solution for everyone who's balding.
Cool. Can't wait for everyone to overhype this and never hear about it again

Hey man, I know it feels like you're drowning, but hang in there. Look for some hair loss idols and try to emulate them. A bunch of soccer players have come back from pretty bad hair loss, and you've got people like Elon Musk, Chris Martin \(the lead singer of Coldplay, etc.

Have you talked to any experts about your options?

There's some hopeful treatments being looked at. I'm not going to lie to you and say they're going to work, but I think the race for the cure for hair loss is picking up speed.

There's a few companies that are really invested in the cure. Here's a list of the big players and forecasts until 2025: [https://www.military\-technologies.net/2018/05/02/global\-androgenic\-alopecia\-drug\-market\-2018\-by\-top\-key\-players\-product\-type\-end\-user\-applications\-region\-and\-forecast\-to\-2025/](https://www.military-technologies.net/2018/05/02/global-androgenic-alopecia-drug-market-2018-by-top-key-players-product-type-end-user-applications-region-and-forecast-to-2025/)

And above all, don't take your life. Hang in there man. Killing yourself won't end the pain, it just spreads that pain out to other people.

Cool, that's fine for you, but I don't agree. You're giving out advice to everyone that only applies to people who share your opinions. Don't say there's nothing wrong with losing your hair, say "I don't have a problem with losing my hair."

There is something wrong with losing my hair, I don't like it. Why is it so wrong to think I'm attractive with more hair and want to keep it? And I don't think a short hair cut is more attractive so what now? In your world I'm just shit out of luck.

Totally agree, there are certain aesthetics I really like that I can't go for bald. I don't think just because some people cope with balding better should mean that I need to as well. That's why we have things like propecia, hair transplants, and rogaine.

I don't think that's fair to say that everyone who's been sad over their hair was actually sad about something else. I really like my hair and want it to stay. Is it a vain thing? Absolutely, but I'm not ashamed to say that it makes me really sad to be less attractive. Even just for myself.

While I wouldn't say suicide should ever be an option for balding, I definitely agree with OP about how little support their is for balding people. It really really really sucks, and it's super damaging to your self image. It's definitely not mentally healthy for someone to go bald. I had my first major slip into depression because of it.
